title: Halloween Family Days Out and Pumpkin Picking Tips
description: Family-friendly Halloween days out: pumpkin picking, spooky-but-not-scary events, theme park Halloween seasons and how to keep the cost of autumn fun down.
h1: Halloween days out and pumpkin picking with kids
intro: Pumpkin patches, glowing trails and friendly spooks. Autumn is one of the best times of year for a family day out. Here’s how to pick the right Halloween fun for your kids’ ages.

image.alt: Two children sitting on a hay bale surrounded by pumpkins

cardText: Pumpkin picking, friendly frights and theme park Halloween seasons for all ages.

blocks.title: Scout’s spooky-meter
blocks.text: Check the scare level before you book. Lots of theme parks run family-friendly daytime Halloween events and much scarier evening events for older teens and adults.
points: Under 8s: pumpkin patches and daytime trails
8 to 12: dressing up and mild spooky shows
Teens: check age limits on scare mazes

sections.html:
Pick-your-own pumpkin farms usually open from late September to Halloween. Many charge an entry fee plus a price per pumpkin, and some include hay-bale mazes, tractor rides or play areas.

  • Book ahead: popular farms use timed slots, especially at weekends.
  • Wear wellies: fields get muddy fast.
  • Bring cash and a bag: or a wheelbarrow if the farm offers one.
  • Go early in the season for the best choice.

Many theme parks theme the whole park for Halloween. Daytime events tend to be family-friendly, while evening “scare” attractions often have minimum ages. Read the event details carefully, and check whether scare attractions cost extra.

• Autumn leaf walks in country parks and forests.
  • Library Halloween crafts and story times.
  • Carving pumpkins at home after a picnic walk.
  • Local fun days and community events, listed on council websites.
Choose costumes that are labelled flame-resistant, add reflective strips for evening events, and agree a meeting point in case anyone gets separated.

faqs.q: When does pumpkin picking season start?
faqs.a: Most pick-your-own pumpkin farms in the UK open from late September or early October until around Halloween. Opening dates vary, so check the farm’s website.

faqs.q: Are theme park Halloween events suitable for young children?
faqs.a: Daytime events are usually family-friendly. Evening scare mazes often have minimum ages and can be frightening for younger children, so check the event guidance before booking.
